name: agentId
label: Agent
help: Select the published agent that should handle the call.

name: phoneNumber
label: Phone number
help: Enter the destination in E.164 format, for example `+12025550100`.

name: metadata
label: Metadata
help: Add values used to personalize the agent. Keys become dynamic variables in the call.

name: agentVersionNumber
label: Agent version number
help: Optional published version. Leave empty to use the latest published version.

name: notes
label: Notes
help: Optional JSON object stored on the call log. DialNexa accepts up to 15 top-level keys.
